subject: maths
question:
If perimeter of the circle is 13.2 cm, then the radius of the circle is ____. 

(Take π = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

The perimeter of the circle (circumference) = 13.2 cm

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter (circumference) of the circle: (C = 2πr)

**Calculation:**

13.2 = 2 × πr

13.2 = 2 × 22/7 × r

r = 2.1 cm

**Therefore, the radius of the circle is 2.1 cm.**
